mostWorthwhile.text: Following insulin to muscle was worthwhile because the result connected glucose uptake to reduced insulin release and showed the response changing over time.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the meal's glucose to the body felt like a predictable setup step; the result added little beyond establishing the starting state.

surprise.text: Nothing was especially surprising, but the later inset showing less insulin release clarified the feedback.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although every gameplay decision offered only one combination, so the sequence left little room for meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be curious to see another body-system relationship, but the single-option sequence makes me hesitant to continue for the gameplay alone.
